name: Ludaic and Elofsson 2026 RNA structure benchmark
description: Independent benchmark of ten deep learning methods on non-redundant monomeric RNAs and RNA-RNA and RNA-protein complexes released after the methods' training cut-offs, split into easy and hard sets by structural similarity to the PDB training data.

attributes.task: RNA 3D structure prediction for monomers and complexes
attributes.scope_note: 79 monomeric RNAs after excluding three long targets that DRfold and DeepFoldRNA did not produce (Methods); 158 complex structures. Easy/hard split for monomers: maximum RNA-align TM-score to the PDB training data at a 0.5 cut-off; for complexes: an RNA or protein chain with TM-score >= 0.7 to a pre-cut-off complex is easy.
attributes.source_locator: Methods 'Benchmark dataset' and 'Model generation'; Results sections on monomers and complexes
limitations: The authors developed none of the benchmarked methods.
Means only; per-target scores are in Supplementary Tables S2-S5 and S9-S14.

limitations: Tables 2 and 3 print identical GDT-TS, INF and lDDT means for DRfold and DeepFoldRNA (0.559, 0.736, 0.481 easy; 0.436, 0.617, 0.361 hard) while their TM-scores differ. The per-target columns for the two methods in Supplementary Tables S3-S5 are also identical, so the duplication is upstream of the means. Not resolved from the source.
Table 3 prints INF 0.668 for RF2NA on the hard set; the mean of the RF2NA column of Supplementary Table S3 (hard rows) is 0.608 by the extractor's own check. Not resolved from the source.
The tables print bold, underline and italic marks for statistical ties (Wilcoxon signed-rank test); the XML carries no formatting, so those marks are not recorded.
